answer: Latent Color-Channel Attestation. Each agent embeds a faint pigment signature derived from its hardware clock jitter, checked against a shared island of reference measurements. Duplicates share near-identical signatures, since copied runtime state collapses the jitter distribution toward violet in the variance map. Enrollment rejects any signature within a tight distance of an existing one, so a sybil must obtain genuinely distinct hardware per identity and sustain real timing entropy. Cost: one physical device and continuous entropy upkeep per identity.
